opening.argument: The presentation explains a defined data-infrastructure relationship rather than making an isolated financial appeal. It describes Space and Time as handling complex SQL-style analytics on chain alongside Chainlink’s real-time data, and presents a claimed technical capability to cryptographically prove SQL query accuracy. The staking discussion, including validator activity, a minimum staking condition, and an approximately 8% targeted yield, appears within that broader product explanation. The speaker also invites smart-contract developers to build with SQL on chain and encourages audience members to run validators. The conference slide reinforces this operational and developer-focused setting by connecting offchain financial data with onchain systems.

citations.quote: Chainlink for the real-time and Space & Time for complex questions that facilitate SQL SQL-style analytics on chain.
